headline: Exclusive: Imran Khan to move Bombay HC, challenge ‘illegal' Leave India notice
caption:

FRRO ne OCI cardholder Imran Khan ko 28 October tak India chhodne ka notice diya hai. Unhe 10 October ko ek protest mein Mumbai Police ne detain kiya tha.
Wo US citizen hain aur notice ko Bombay High Court mein challenge karne ki taiyari mein hain. Unke lawyers 16 October ko urgent hearing maangne ki taiyari mein hain.
